description: Land Title Settlement Department - Hadirawalana Ihalagama, Kurunegala D/S Division, Kurunegala District  - Cad. Map No. 420350
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement determining ownership of specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, owner names, and title classifications. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land property matters, fitting the definition of Land Gazettes (Type 4).
